title: EEG data from an auditory oddball task
description: EEG recordings from an auditory oddball task collected at the Meditation Research Institute in Rishikesh, India. Participants completed three sessions of a P300 paradigm with standard tones, oddball tones and white-noise distractors while sitting with their eyes closed in a darkened room. The dataset supports research on auditory event-related potentials and attention.
methods_description: Participants completed three identical 13-minute sessions of 750 stimuli each. 70% were standard 500 Hz tones, 15% were oddball 1000 Hz tones and 15% were 1000 Hz white-noise distractors. Sounds lasted 60 ms with 5 ms ramps and were presented at 1 per second with a Gaussian jitter (SD 25 ms). Participants pressed a key on a keypad in response to oddball tones. They sat with eyes closed in a dark room.
